nodes.label: CLI Entrypoint
nodes.desc: main() parses flags and service configuration, then boots the engine flow.

nodes.label: Config & Plugins
nodes.desc: flb_config_init() builds the service context and registers input, parser, filter, and output instances.

nodes.label: Engine Core
nodes.desc: flb_engine_start() runs the event loop that drives collection, flushing, and shutdown.

nodes.label: Collectors
nodes.desc: flb_input_collectors_start() launches the fd, timer, and coroutine callbacks each input registers.

nodes.label: Input Plugins
nodes.desc: 70+ built-in input plugins such as in_tail_collect_event() read files, sockets, and endpoints.

nodes.label: Chunk Buffering
nodes.desc: flb_input_chunk_write() buffers ingested records into tagged chunks, optionally on the filesystem.

nodes.label: Parser Registry
nodes.desc: flb_parser_create() registers JSON, regex, and multiline parsers that turn raw text into structured records.

nodes.label: Filter Chain
nodes.desc: flb_filter_do() passes each chunk through the ordered chain of grep, Lua, modify, and other filters.

nodes.label: Tag Router
nodes.desc: flb_router_match() compares chunk tags with output match rules to select destinations.

nodes.label: Tasks & Retries
nodes.desc: flb_task_create() packages routed event chunks per output and flb_task_retry_reschedule() requeues failures.

nodes.label: Output Plugins
nodes.desc: Output plugins like cb_forward_flush() serialize chunks and hand them to the network layer.

nodes.label: Upstream & HTTP
nodes.desc: flb_upstream_create() manages pooled TLS connections and flb_http_do() performs async delivery.
